text_en: Three years later, word came to Judas and his men that Demetrius son of Seleucus had sailed into the harbor of Tripolis with a strong army and a fleet,
text_cn: 过了三年，犹大和他的部下知道色娄苛的儿子德默特琉带着大军及战船已在特黎颇里海口登陆，

text_en: and had taken possession of the country, having made away with Antiochus and his guardian Lysias.
text_cn: 占领那地，杀了安提约古及他的监护人里息雅。

text_en: Now a certain Alcimus, who had formerly been high priest but had willfully defiled himself in the times of separation, realized that there was no way for him to be safe or to have access again to the holy altar,
text_cn: 从前任大司祭的阿耳基慕，在与外邦人绝交时期，曾甘心自污，自知无论如何不得安全，也不能再走近圣坛；

text_en: and went to King Demetrius in about the one hundred fifty-first year, presenting to him a crown of gold and a palm, and besides these some of the customary olive branches from the temple. During that day he kept quiet.
text_cn: 于是在一五一年，去见德默特琉王，献给他一顶金冠和金棕榈枝，此外还献上些圣殿内常供奉的橄榄枝；他那一天没有说什么。

text_en: But he found an opportunity that furthered his mad purpose when he was invited by Demetrius to a meeting of the council and was asked about the attitude and intentions of the Jews. He answered:
text_cn: 但当德默特琉召他来会议，询问他犹太人有何心思和企图时，他便乘机贡献那无耻的计策说：

text_en: “Those of the Jews who are called Hasideans, whose leader is Judas Maccabeus, are keeping up war and stirring up sedition, and will not let the kingdom attain tranquility.
text_cn: “有一些号称哈息待的，并以犹大玛加伯为领袖的犹太人，时常发动战争，叛变无常，不让国家获得安宁。

text_en: Therefore I have laid aside my ancestral glory—I mean the high priesthood—and have now come here,
text_cn: 因此，我既然被他们剥夺了祖传的光荣，即大司祭的地位，现今我来到这里：

text_en: first because I am genuinely concerned for the interests of the king, and second because I have regard also for my compatriots. For through the folly of those whom I have mentioned our whole nation is now in no small misfortune.
text_cn: 第一，是为诚心图谋国王的福利；第二，是为替我同胞着想，因为，因了上述那些人的胆大妄为，我们整个民族受到不少的苦楚。

text_en: Since you are acquainted, O king, with the details of this matter, may it please you to take thought for our country and our hard-pressed nation with the gracious kindness that you show to all.
text_cn: 如今请陛下将这些事先一一调查清楚，以后设法依照陛下对天下所怀的仁德，照顾我们的家乡，及我们遭难的民族，

text_en: For as long as Judas lives, it is impossible for the government to find peace. ”
text_cn: 因为犹大一息尚存，国家决不能平安。”

text_en: When he had said this, the rest of the king’s Friends, who were hostile to Judas, quickly inflamed Demetrius still more.
text_cn: 他正说这些话时，其他憎恨犹大的亲信，也在旁激动德默特琉的愤怒。

text_en: He immediately chose Nicanor, who had been in command of the elephants, appointed him governor of Judea, and sent him off
text_cn: 于是国王立即选定曾任象队司令的尼加诺尔，委他为犹太总督，派他前去；

text_en: with orders to kill Judas and scatter his troops, and to install Alcimus as high priest of the great temple.
text_cn: 令他去杀犹大，解散他的部下，立阿耳基慕为那庄严圣殿的司祭长。

text_en: And the Gentiles throughout Judea, who had fled before Judas, flocked to join Nicanor, thinking that the misfortunes and calamities of the Jews would mean prosperity for themselves.
text_cn: 犹太各地被犹大所驱逐的外邦人，便都成群结队来协助尼加诺尔，认为犹太人的不幸和灾害，都于自己有利。

text_en: When the Jews heard of Nicanor’s coming and the gathering of the Gentiles, they sprinkled dust on their heads and prayed to him who established his own people forever and always upholds his own heritage by manifesting himself.
text_cn: 犹太人听说尼加诺尔来侵，外邦人来犯，便头上撒土，哀号那位永远保存自己的民族，又常显奇迹保护自己产业的天主，

text_en: At the command of the leader, they set out from there immediately and engaged them in battle at a village called Dessau.
text_cn: 然后遵照领袖的命令，立时从那里动身，在德扫村与敌人交锋。

text_en: Simon, the brother of Judas, had encountered Nicanor, but had been temporarily checked because of the sudden consternation created by the enemy.
text_cn: 犹大的兄弟息孟已经与尼加诺尔交战，但因敌兵的突击，稍感不利。

text_en: Nevertheless Nicanor, hearing of the valor of Judas and his troops and their courage in battle for their country, shrank from deciding the issue by bloodshed.
text_cn: 可是，尼加诺尔因为听说犹大和他的部下骁勇善战，以及他们为国作战的雄心，不敢用武力来解决，

text_en: Therefore he sent Posidonius, Theodotus, and Mattathias to give and receive pledges of friendship.
text_cn: 于是派颇息多尼、特奥多托和玛塔提雅去与犹太人商议和谈。

text_en: When the terms had been fully considered, and the leader had informed the people, and it had appeared that they were of one mind, they agreed to the covenant.
text_cn: 将条件详细考虑后，首领通知众军队，大家既一致赞同，他才同意讲和。

text_en: The leaders set a day on which to meet by themselves. A chariot came forward from each army; seats of honor were set in place;
text_cn: 双方也规定了同到一地会商的日期，那天，各乘轿车来就已布置好的席位。

text_en: Judas posted armed men in readiness at key places to prevent sudden treachery on the part of the enemy; so they duly held the consultation.
text_cn: 犹大在适宜的地方派兵防守，以免敌人背信突击；双方的谈判终于获得协议。

text_en: Nicanor stayed on in Jerusalem and did nothing out of the way, but dismissed the flocks of people that had gathered.
text_cn: 尼加诺尔逗留在耶路撒冷时，没有做出什么越轨的事，而且还解散了那些来协助他的队伍。

text_en: And he kept Judas always in his presence; he was warmly attached to the man.
text_cn: 他常要犹大在自己的身边，心里也很喜欢他；

text_en: He urged him to marry and have children; so Judas married, settled down, and shared the common life.
text_cn: 于是劝他娶妻生子，犹大便娶了妻子，享受人生乐趣。

text_en: But when Alcimus noticed their goodwill for one another, he took the covenant that had been made and went to Demetrius. He told him that Nicanor was disloyal to the government, since he had appointed that conspirator against the kingdom, Judas, to be his successor.
text_cn: 阿耳基慕见他们二人交好，便带了一份订的和约，到德默特琉面前，说尼加诺尔对国事有异心，因为他已指定了叛国的犹大为自己的继承人。

text_en: The king became excited and, provoked by the false accusations of that depraved man, wrote to Nicanor, stating that he was displeased with the covenant and commanding him to send Maccabeus to Antioch as a prisoner without delay.
text_cn: 王被这恶徒的谗言所惑，勃然大怒，写信给尼加诺尔，表示不满意他所订的和约，并命令他从速逮捕玛加伯，把他解送到安提约基雅去。

text_en: When this message came to Nicanor, he was troubled and grieved that he had to annul their agreement when the man had done no wrong.
text_cn: 尼加诺尔得到这道谕令，极感不安，因为对方没有什么不对，不好轻易违背与他订的和约；

text_en: Since it was not possible to oppose the king, he watched for an opportunity to accomplish this by a stratagem.
text_cn: 但又不能违抗君王，所以只好寻找机会，运用机智来完成这道命令。

text_en: But Maccabeus, noticing that Nicanor was more austere in his dealings with him and was meeting him more rudely than had been his custom, concluded that this austerity did not spring from the best motives. So he gathered not a few of his men, and went into hiding from Nicanor.
text_cn: 玛加伯见尼加诺尔对自己冷淡，谈话的态度也比以前粗暴，便了解这种粗暴态度决非好现象；于是召集自己不少的部下，暗自离开了尼加诺尔。

text_en: When the latter became aware that he had been cleverly outwitted by the man, he went to the great and holy temple while the priests were offering the customary sacrifices, and commanded them to hand the man over.
text_cn: 尼加诺尔见自己被犹大玩弄，便在司祭正献日常祭时，闯进庄严的圣殿，命他们交出玛加伯来。

text_en: When they declared on oath that they did not know where the man was whom he wanted,
text_cn: 他们就起誓说不知道他找的人在那里。

text_en: he stretched out his right hand toward the sanctuary, and swore this oath: “If you do not hand Judas over to me as a prisoner, I will level this shrine of God to the ground and tear down the altar, and build here a splendid temple to Dionysus. ”
text_cn: 他就向圣殿伸出右手发誓道：“你们若不将犹大逮捕交给我，我要将天主的这座殿宇夷为平地，将祭坛拆毁，并在这里给雕尼索建筑一座壮丽的庙宇。”

text_en: Having said this, he went away. Then the priests stretched out their hands toward heaven and called upon the constant Defender of our nation, in these words:
text_cn: 说完这话就走了。司祭们举手向天，呼求那常为自己的民族作战者说：

text_en: “O Lord of all, though you have need of nothing, you were pleased that there should be a temple for your habitation among us;
text_cn: “万有的上主！你一无所缺，但是你却乐意在我们中有一座圣殿作你的住所。

text_en: so now, O holy One, Lord of all holiness, keep undefiled forever this house that has been so recently purified. ”
text_cn: 那么，至圣的上主！求你保护这座才洁净的圣殿，使它永远不再受亵渎！”

text_en: A certain Razis, one of the elders of Jerusalem, was denounced to Nicanor as a man who loved his compatriots and was very well thought of and for his goodwill was called father of the Jews.
text_cn: 在耶路撒冷有长老，名叫辣齐斯，被人在尼加诺尔跟前控告了；他原是热心爱国，极负盛名的人，因为为人慈祥，人都称他为犹太人之父。

text_en: In former times, when there was no mingling with the Gentiles, he had been accused of Judaism, and he had most zealously risked body and life for Judaism.
text_cn: 他在与外邦人绝交的初期，也曾因犹太教而被控告；他已决意为犹太教牺牲自身和性命。

text_en: Nicanor, wishing to exhibit the enmity that he had for the Jews, sent more than five hundred soldiers to arrest him;
text_cn: 尼加诺尔为发泄自己对犹太人所怀的仇恨，便派了五百多人去捉拿他，

text_en: for he thought that by arresting him he would do them an injury.
text_cn: 认为逮捕这个人，一定能给犹太人一个极大的打击。

text_en: When the troops were about to capture the tower and were forcing the door of the courtyard, they ordered that fire be brought and the doors burned. Being surrounded, Razis fell upon his own sword,
text_cn: 当军队正要占据堡垒，撞开庭院大门，下令放火烧门时，辣齐斯见四面受敌，便伏剑自刎，

text_en: preferring to die nobly rather than to fall into the hands of sinners and suffer outrages unworthy of his noble birth.
text_cn: 宁愿壮烈牺牲不愿陷在恶人手中，使自己的身份遭受不堪的凌辱。

text_en: But in the heat of the struggle he did not hit exactly, and the crowd was now rushing in through the doors. He courageously ran up on the wall, and bravely threw himself down into the crowd.
text_cn: 但因伏剑过急，没有刺中要害，那时敌人已闯进门内，他便奋身跑到墙上，毅然跳到人群中。

text_en: But as they quickly drew back, a space opened and he fell in the middle of the empty space.
text_cn: 众人都急忙后退，让出一块空地，他便落在空地上。

text_en: Still alive and aflame with anger, he rose, and though his blood gushed forth and his wounds were severe he ran through the crowd; and standing upon a steep rock,
text_cn: 这时他还活着，于是怒火如焚的爬起来，虽然血流如注，伤势甚重，还跑着穿过人群，屹立在一块岩石上；

text_en: with his blood now completely drained from him, he tore out his entrails, took them in both hands and hurled them at the crowd, calling upon the Lord of life and spirit to give them back to him again. This was the manner of his death.
text_cn: 血快要流尽的时候，又将五脏扯出来，双手捧着，向人群抛去，恳求那掌管生命及灵魂的主宰，把这一切再还给他；他就这样死了。
